title: A late transaction.updated webhook overwrites a completed transaction with an older status

bugs.note: Paddle does not deliver webhooks in order. handleTransactionUpdated writes whatever status the payload carries, so an updated event for the billed or paid state that arrives after transaction.completed moves a completed, charged transaction back to an earlier status and fires TransactionUpdated with it. The local record no longer shows the payment as completed.
